boards.title: 首页与模式选择
boards.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce one high-resolution presentation board containing exactly FOUR full application screen mockups in a clean 2-column by 2-row grid. Each individual screen is landscape 5:3, designed for 800×480 touch display. Overall board landscape approximately 5:3. Generous legible Chinese typography, crisp detail. Each screen has an understated outer caption with its specified page ID and title. Do not crop. No device frames, no perspective, no browser chrome.
Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. Continue and refine this FOCUS design language: luminous pale ice-blue/off-white background, white softly elevated rounded cards, navy headings, bright blue player1 and warm orange player2, restrained teal ready status, amber simulation pill, consistent simple custom icons. School children and teens: polished friendly sports/science product, not infantile. Large readable text and touch controls. Reduce unnecessary decoration compared to reference. FOCUS small in header; keep visible badge "模拟体验" in every screen. Never label generated values as real hardware measurements.
Render supplied simplified Chinese text faithfully. Clear practical layouts that fit each 800x480 screen, no dense technical clutter. Use ordinary short labels and the exact supplied numbers. Avoid extra paragraphs, fake illegible text, watermark, gradients under text. Buttons about56px at original design scale, fixed action positions. Matching visual design across screens. These are static conceptual designs, not claims of implemented functionality.

TOP LEFT A01 “正在启动”: FOCUS centered with simple focus-wave icon, gentle small progress indicator, headline "正在连接训练服务", short text "准备好后将进入首页", small outlined "重新检查". Footer "无需联网". No fake completion percentage.
TOP RIGHT A02 “首页”: title "今天，练习一下专注吧". Two large equal navigation cards: "专注训练" with instrument-dial illustration and subtitle "单人或双人，一起练习"; "小车竞速" with blue/orange car illustration and subtitle "双人挑战，快乐出发". Lower quiet links "我的记录" and "教师入口". Space is generous, only two main choices.
BOTTOM LEFT A03 “选择训练人数”: back link "返回首页", title "你想怎样练习？". Two large selectable cards "单人训练" with one blue avatar and "双人训练" with blue+orange avatars. Dual card visibly selected with outline/check. Primary bottom button "下一步". No performance ranking.
BOTTOM RIGHT A04 “确认玩家”: back link "上一步"; step indicator "选择玩家 → 佩戴头环 → 开始". Two side-by-side cards "玩家 1" blue circular avatar labeled "小蓝" and "玩家 2" orange diamond avatar labeled "小橙"; secondary control in each "更换玩家". Bottom brief summary "双人训练 · 3 分钟" then blue "去准备". No keyboard, names are fictional local nicknames.
